composer:dompdf/dompdf.reason: Laravel Cashier draws the PDF of a billing invoice with it (`DompdfInvoiceRenderer`, the default `cashier.invoices.renderer`), for `settings.billing.invoices.download`. It is used as installed from Packagist, unmodified, so the LGPL asks for what this file and the package's own licence text already give: the notice, the licence text, and a copy you can replace (`composer update dompdf/dompdf` or another `InvoiceRenderer`).

composer:dompdf/php-font-lib.reason: Required by dompdf/dompdf (above), with the same use and the same duties.

composer:dompdf/php-svg-lib.reason: Required by dompdf/dompdf (above), with the same use and the same duties.

npm:elkjs.reason: A dependency of @unovis/ts (graph layouts). Nothing in the built front end imports it (looked for in public/build on 2026-11-01, and `npm run build` is the place to look again if a chart type that lays out a graph is added), and it is unmodified. The Eclipse Public License asks that the source of what is distributed stays available, which the unmodified package on npm is.
